description: List shelf records, each hydrated with a preview of the books on it. At most `booksPerShelf` books are returned per shelf; read a full shelf with `listBooksOnShelf`. Answers are cut at a fixed deadline rather than holding the request open, so a shelf under load may come back with fewer books than asked for.

did.description: Scope the read to one account's shelves. Omitted, the read is network-wide across every account.

limit.description: Maximum number of shelves to return.

booksPerShelf.description: Maximum number of books to hydrate per shelf. This query is a preview: `listBooksOnShelf` is the complete, paginated listing for one shelf.
